Program: Deliver a governed and recoverable institutional repository beta
Vision: docs/vision.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Pilot guide: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Local milestone: docs/local-demo-plan.md

One institution hosting several labs and selected external collaborators (user-confirmed)

Outcome: Meet the lab/project repository promise within an explicitly accepted institutional scope.
Completion: All eight required epics and every conditional epic activated by SITE01.3 pass with retained evidence. EP9 reviews all six core areas and one integrated release; EP0 qualifies the local demo and guide before SITE01 institutional outreach/acceptance. Q03.3 records the later named institutional pilot go/no-go; production source cutover remains separate.

Current plan: eight required and two conditional epics, 26 acceptance gates and 79 tasks. EP9 coordinates existing work through six area reviews and one integrated-release review; eight new engineering tasks fill identified gaps. Existing task IDs, hierarchy and completed receipts are retained. See the core plan for ordered tranches, WIP limits, ownership and stop/retest rules. Institutional gates remain later than the core/local demonstration.

Definition of done:
- Deliver the stated behavior, satisfy every acceptance criterion and retain the stated evidence; a failed/not-run criterion remains open.
- Use existing scientific acceptance, identity, authority and durable-operation contracts. Preserve unrelated work and exact historical releases.
- Exercise relevant positive, negative, concurrency, failure and compatibility scenarios; run the suites appropriate to changed boundaries, not unrelated tests by rote.
- Record commands/procedures, actual outcomes, source/artifact/configuration identity and limits. Do not substitute synthetic/provider-mock/automated-accessibility evidence for a required institutional or human result.
- A gate is an integration/evidence review, not duplicate implementation work. Epic/program closure requires their gates and a current dependency check.
- Scope new implementation to a reviewable change; if discovery makes a leaf too broad, split it into blocking child work before claiming completion.
- Institutional tasks record missing information and accountable roles without inventing acceptance or sending unsolicited messages.
- Conditional epics require an explicit SITE01.3 scope decision. Deferred does not mean implemented; activate blockers before commencing selected conditional work.
